style.palette_sha256: <sha256 of the profile's colour list as written in palettes.json>

conventions.rotation: camera-to-world quaternion of the camera transform used for rendering this frame (after snapping)

motion.notes: camera driven by the capture script, not by player input; all animation and VFX time frozen except camera

encodings.color_internal: 8-bit sRGB PNG, RGB, no alpha; final palette-quantised image before upscale and before UI
encodings.color_output: 8-bit sRGB PNG, RGB, no alpha; the presented frame (after upscale and sub-pixel compensation), UI layer disabled
encodings.palette_index: 8-bit greyscale PNG at internal resolution; value = index into the profile colour list; 255 = not palette-quantised

depth.quantity: eye-space linear depth z (m) along the camera forward axis
depth.decode: z = near_m * (far_m / near_m) ** (v / 65535); v = 65535 means sky / no geometry
depth.alternative: EXR float32 single channel, same quantity, inf for sky (optional)

encodings.mask_animated: 8-bit PNG at internal resolution; 255 = pixel covered by an animated element excluded from M-004
